text:
Lee Romero: hey @jordan_people_ops — i've been having worsening wrist pain (likely early carpal tunnel). doc recommends ergonomic adjustments and reduced repetitive typing for ~10 weeks. can we start an accommodation?

Jordan (People Ops): thanks for flagging, Lee. sorry you're dealing with pain. yes we can open the interactive process. could you DM a short provider note and we'll keep it confidential. any immediate workarounds you need?

Lee Romero: DM'd the note. immediate: fewer long review sessions, fewer back-to-back PRs, and permission to use voice-to-text for writeups. also may need a temporary decrease in code review quota.

Maya R: Lee — happy to take extra CRs. I can also triage smaller PRs so you only get the high-scope ones.

Terry (Eng Manager): i'll reassign up to 40% of your review load for 8-10 weeks and ask the team to batch review blocks to limit context switching. Lee, would two 45-min review blocks per day work instead of ad-hoc pings?

Lee Romero: two blocks sounds helpful. also would like a small keyboard and wrist rest — can IT expedite procurement?

Jordan (People Ops): proposed plan:
- temporary CR quota reduction to 60% for 10 weeks
- scheduled review windows (11:00-11:45, 15:00-15:45)
- allow voice-to-text for docs and PR descriptions
- IT to ship ergo keyboard + wrist rest within 7 business days
- 30-day check-in with manager + people-ops
we'll record this in an accommodations note limited to manager, people-ops, and IT contacts on a need-to-know basis.

Terry (Eng Manager): noted. i'll update team rota and set expectations in the weekly standup. we'll also create a lightweight success checklist for the 30-day review so reviewers know which PRs to prioritize.

Maya R: i can mentor a temporary contractor if extra review capacity is needed. hiring ops — is short-term contract approval fast? @hiring_ops

Hiring Ops Bot: Contracting request guide: submit request form -> approval ~3 business days for <$10k engagements. link: https://intranet.redwood/contracting. Use tag #urgent if it's time-sensitive.

Jordan (People Ops): if a contractor helps, we can fast-track an approval note for 6-8 week coverage. prefer to reassign internally first.

Lee Romero: thanks, everyone. one question: will this affect my performance notes? i had a minor sync where backlog piled last sprint and i'm worried.

Jordan (People Ops): accommodations are protected and shouldn't be used punitively. we'll document agreed deliverables and the review checklist; any separate performance concerns will be handled separately and managers will note the accommodation on need-to-know basis only.

Terry (Eng Manager): i'll separate backlog items from accom planning. goal is to keep you productive while you recover.

Lee Romero: appreciate the fast help. please send the secure upload link if you need additional provider info.

Jordan (People Ops): will send secure link and schedule the intake meeting for the next available slot. action items: Jordan to send link + intake invite, IT to expedite ergo gear, Terry to update review schedule and coverage, Maya to assist with mentoring contractor if approved.

Lee Romero: thank you all. :relieved:
